svg.title: Omarchy x AI — Fred Nix
svg.desc: The Omarchy logo mark above a large OMARCHY x AI wordmark set in Omarchy's own typeface, over a mock Omarchy top bar carrying real Ollama, Codex and Grok glyphs, and three pillars: the bar, the collaborator and the fleet.
svg.text: MY ACTUAL BAR · MUSIC PLAYING · LOCAL MODEL ON THE GPU · CODEX MID-SESSION
a desktop worth instrumenting, and the AI that instruments it
A dozen bar plugins of my own:
Claude Code and Codex, plus models
on a local nano host and this laptop.
one bar watching all of it.
FRED “SPIKE” NIX · AI INFRASTRUCTURE ARCHITECT · ATLANTA
